name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Automatically import bank and credit-card transactions from SimpleFin, with correct balances, pending reconciliation, and internal-transfer linking.

release.notes: Categories in the addon are now organised into collapsible budget groups matching Wealthfolio's own Spending Tracker (Needs, Wants, Savings, Giving, Personal, Other), read live from its budget-group tables so groups and categories added, renamed or reordered in Wealthfolio appear automatically.
